### `fdasrvf`
[R]{.badge .text-bg-primary} [MATLAB]{.badge .text-bg-secondary} [Julia]{.badge .text-bg-secondary}

Lead author. Alignment, PCA, and modeling of multidimensional and unidimensional functions using the square-root velocity framework (Srivastava et al., 2011 [arXiv:1103.3817](https://arxiv.org/abs/1103.3817) and Tucker et al., 2013 [doi:10.1016/j.csda.2012.12.001](Papers/CSDA_PCA_12.pdf)). This framework allows for elastic analysis of functional data through phase and amplitude separation. Multiple papers use the work in this package, and it is listed in the [CRAN Functional Data Analysis Task View](https://cran.r-project.org/web/views/FunctionalData.html). See the package README for all the methods it implements and reference papers.

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/fdasrvf/index.html) · [GitHub](https://github.com/jdtuck/fdasrvf_R) · [MATLAB](https://github.com/jdtuck/fdasrvf_MATLAB) · [Julia](https://github.com/jdtuck/ElasticFDA.jl) · [Julia docs](https://elasticfdajl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### `fdasrsf`
[Python]{.badge .text-bg-primary}

Lead author. The Python version of `fdasrvf`: alignment, PCA, and modeling of functional data using the square-root velocity framework, with elastic analysis through phase and amplitude separation. Multiple papers use the work in this package and are listed in the documentation. See the package README for all the methods it implements and reference papers.

[PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/fdasrsf/) · [Conda](https://anaconda.org/conda-forge/fdasrsf) · [GitHub](https://github.com/jdtuck/fdasrsf_python) · [Docs](https://fdasrsf-python.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### `stpphawkes`
[R]{.badge .text-bg-primary}

Lead author. Modeling spatio-temporal and temporal point processes using a Hawkes model accounting for missing data, from J. D. Tucker, L. Shand, and J. R. Lewis, "Handling Missing Data in Self-Exciting Point Process Models," *Spatial Statistics*, vol. 29, pp. 160-176, 2019. [PDF](Papers/SPATSTAT18_STPP.pdf)

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/stpphawkes/index.html) · [GitHub](https://github.com/sandialabs/stpphawkes)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .h-100}

### `impala`
[R]{.badge .text-bg-primary} [MATLAB]{.badge .text-bg-secondary}

Developer. Modular Bayesian model calibration. Posterior exploration includes tempering and adaptive MCMC. This is a translation of the Python library [impala](https://github.com/lanl/impala) by LANL.

[GitHub - R](https://github.com/sandialabs/rImpala) · [GitHub - MATLAB](https://github.com/sandialabs/impala_matlab)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### `mvBayes`
[R]{.badge .text-bg-primary} [Python]{.badge .text-bg-secondary} [MATLAB]{.badge .text-bg-secondary}

Developer. Implementation of the multivariate Bayesian regression (mvBayes) framework. Decomposes a multivariate/functional response using a user-specified orthogonal basis decomposition, and then models each basis component independently using an arbitrary user-specified (univariate) Bayesian regression model. Includes prediction and plotting methods.

[GitHub - R](https://github.com/sandialabs/mvBayesR) · [GitHub - Python](https://github.com/sandialabs/mvBayesPy) · [GitHub - MATLAB](https://github.com/sandialabs/mvBayes_matlab)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .h-100}

### `EFBMC`
